turnaround_reason: Sarepta collapsed after multiple patient deaths (acute liver failure) tied to its AAVrh74 gene-therapy platform led the FDA to halt Elevidys shipments (later partially reinstated for ambulatory patients only) and place LGMD trials on clinical hold. Revenue fell ~34%. The 'recovering' screen reflects a bounce off the lows, not a resolved crisis.
bullish_points: Off its lows (~$19.5 vs 52-wk low $14.68); still a commercial DMD franchise with the PMO antisense products
FDA allowed Elevidys shipments to resume for ambulatory patients, preserving part of the revenue base
fwd P/E ~7.6 and strong liquidity (current ratio ~4.4) give runway to work through the crisis
Analyst mean target (~$22) sits above the current price
bearish_points: Three patient deaths this year -- an existential safety overhang on the core AAV platform
FDA revoked the AAVrh74 platform-therapy designation, kneecapping the pipeline's regulatory fast-track
LGMD gene-therapy trials on clinical hold; Elevidys restricted to ambulatory patients only
Revenue -34% YoY with negative gross margin (-17%) -- severe operational impairment
Stock is prone to violent two-way moves on every headline; extreme binary risk
catalyst: Regulatory clarity on the platform (LGMD hold lifted, safety mitigations accepted) and a Q3 print showing Elevidys revenue stabilizing
catalyst_timing: Q3 2026 earnings ~2026-11-04; regulatory updates are event-driven and unpredictable
suggested_trade: Pass / watchlist only. Too much unquantifiable safety and regulatory tail risk to size a position. Speculative traders: tiny, defined-risk options at most.
key_risk: Further safety events or a full FDA withdrawal of Elevidys would gut the franchise -- the downside is not floored.
would_skip_if: Any new safety signal, an adverse FDA action, or continued Elevidys revenue decline -- the risk is fundamentally uncapped here.
